features.title:
Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.
features.subtitle: Purpose-built for instructors who want a powerful, flexible, and affordable assessment tool — not a bloated enterprise suite.

cards.title: Diverse Question Types
cards.desc: Multiple choice, short answer, fill-in-the-blank, matching, ordering, and more — all serving different learning outcomes to meet pedagogical goals.

cards.title: Instant Auto-Grading
cards.desc: Save hours every week. LearnUps automatically grades submissions and syncs scores back to your LMS grade book in real time.

cards.title: Deep Analytics
cards.desc: See which questions students struggle with most. Track performance trends, identify learning gaps, and iterate on your content.

cards.title: LTI Integration
cards.desc: Connect LearnUps to Canvas, Moodle, or any LTI-compatible LMS with a few clicks. Grades sync automatically — no manual exports.

cards.title: Open Education Resources
cards.desc: Adopt OER content and we'll help you build assessments around it — saving you weeks of question-writing time.

cards.title: Academic Integrity
cards.desc: Randomized question pools, time limits, and per-student question shuffling make every attempt unique and harder to share answers.
